title: Hope Always Her Helper
description: In this poem by Kawsar K, an EmpowerHer student, the writer tells the story of Sanam, a bright and determined Afghan girl whose dreams of studying law and psychology are threatened by Taliban oppression. Despite fear and hardship, Sanam refuses to surrender her hope. Through resilience, quiet strength, and dedication to learning, she becomes a symbol of courage, showing that even when dreams are attacked, the human spirit can continue to rise.
